HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_REQUIRED_DESC: CI Hub needs Docker Desktop to run your apps and services. We'll automatically detect when Docker is ready.
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_ALREADY_INSTAL: If Docker Desktop is already installed:
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_NOT_INSTALLED_: If Docker Desktop is NOT installed:
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_WINDOWS_STEP_O: Open Docker Desktop from your Start Menu
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_WINDOWS_STEP_W: Wait for Docker to start (you'll see the whale icon in your system tray)
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_MAC_STEP_OPEN_: Open Docker Desktop from your Applications folder
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_MAC_STEP_WAIT_: Wait for Docker to start (you'll see the whale icon in your menu bar)
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_MAC_STEP_OPEN_: Open the .dmg and drag Docker to Applications
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_MAC_STEP_LAUNC: Launch Docker Desktop and grant permissions
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_STEP_RUN_INSTA: Run the installer and follow the prompts
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_STEP_COME_BACK: Come back here. The Hub will continue automatically
Come back here. The Hub will start automatically
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_DESKTOP_WINDOWS_HINT: Docker Desktop requires Windows 10/11 with WSL2 enabled. If WSL is installed during setup, restart Windows before reopening CI Hub.
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_ENGINE_REQUIRED_DESC: CI Hub requires Docker to run.
HUB_STATUS_LINUX_STEP_INSTALL_ENGINE: Install Docker Engine for your Linux distribution
HUB_STATUS_LINUX_STEP_ADD_USER_GROUP: Add your user to the docker group
HUB_STATUS_LINUX_STEP_LOG_OUT: Log out and back in, or restart your machine
HUB_STATUS_LINUX_INSTALL_NEEDS_RESTART: Docker installed. Log out and back in for group membership to take effect, then reopen CI Hub.
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_ALT_DESC_MAC: Docker Desktop requires a paid subscription for organizations with more than 250 employees or more than $10M in annual revenue. Colima runs the open-source Docker Engine in a lightweight VM. No Docker Desktop license required.
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_ALT_DESC_WINDOWS: Docker Desktop requires a paid subscription for organizations with more than 250 employees or more than $10M in annual revenue. CI Hub can instead run the open-source Docker Engine inside WSL2. No Docker Desktop license required.
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_ALT_INSTALLING: Installing… the first run downloads a VM image and can take several minutes.
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_ALT_SUCCESS: Installed. Docker should become available momentarily.
HUB_STATUS_DOCKER_ALT_NEEDS_RESTART: WSL was installed or enabled. Restart Windows, then reopen CI Hub to continue setup.
HUB_STATUS_STARTING_STILL_WORKING: Still working - Docker images may be downloading for the first time.
HUB_STATUS_STARTING_ALMOST_THERE: Almost there - some services are taking longer than usual.
HUB_STATUS_STARTING_FIRST_STARTUP_NOTE: This might take a minute on first startup while containers are pulled.
UPDATE_BANNER_AVAILABLE_PRESERVED: is available - your Hub data and settings are preserved.
ROOT_ERROR_BOUNDARY_PAGE_NOT_FOUND: The requested page could not be found.
HUB_STATUS_BACKEND_NOT_RUNNING: The CI Hub backend is not running.
MEMORY_CONNECT_DESC: Let this app remember your context across sessions by connecting it to your CI Memory.
MEMORY_CONNECT_DISCONNECT_DESC: Stop this app from remembering your context by disconnecting it from your CI Memory.
MEMORY_CONNECT_NOT_INSTALLED: Install CI Memory to let this app remember your context across sessions.
MEMORY_CONNECT_UNAVAILABLE_TOAST: CI Memory isn't ready to connect yet. Please try again once it's running.
MEMORY_CONNECT_ERROR_TOAST: Couldn't connect to CI Memory. Please try again.
MEMORY_CONNECT_DISCONNECT_ERROR: Could not disconnect. Please try again.
MEMORY_CONNECT_DISCONNECT_CONFIRM: This revokes the app's access to your CI Memory and restarts it. You can reconnect at any time.
MEMORY_CONNECT_FINISHING_DESC: Restarting {{name}} to apply your CI Memory connection. This usually takes under a minute…
MEMORY_CONNECT_FINISHING_PROPAGATING_DES: Connected! {{name}} is back up — its public address is still propagating. This usually takes a few more seconds…
Connected! The app is back up — its public address is still propagating. This usually takes a few more seconds…
MEMORY_CONNECT_FINISHING_PROPAGATING_TIM: Your CI Memory connection was saved, but {{name}}'s web address is still not responding. You can try opening it anyway, or manage it from the dashboard.
Your CI Memory connection was saved, but the app's web address is still not responding. You can manage it from the dashboard.
MEMORY_CONNECT_FINISHING_ERROR_TITLE: The app didn't come back up
MEMORY_CONNECT_FINISHING_ERROR_DESC: Your CI Memory connection was saved, but {{name}} failed to restart. You can try opening it anyway, or manage it from the dashboard.
MEMORY_CONNECT_FINISHING_TIMEOUT_DESC: Your CI Memory connection was saved, but {{name}} is taking longer than expected to restart.
MEMORY_CONNECT_FINISHING_DESC_GENERIC: Restarting the app to apply your CI Memory connection. This usually takes under a minute…
MEMORY_CONNECT_FINISHING_READY_DONE: Connected! You can open the app from the dashboard.
MEMORY_CONNECT_FINISHING_ERROR_DESC_GENE: This app could not be reached. You can manage your apps from the dashboard.
MEMORY_CONNECT_FINISHING_TIMEOUT_DESC_GE: This app is taking longer than expected to restart. You can manage it from the dashboard.
ONBOARDING_ACCESS_VPN_CONNECT_BELOW: Connect Tailscale below to finish setup.
ONBOARDING_ACCESS_LOCAL_BASELINE_NOTE: You can always open your Hub on this computer, even without Web or Private VPN.
ONBOARDING_ACCESS_LOCAL_ONLY_NOTE: Local only for now. Your Hub stays on this computer until you turn on Web or Private VPN.
ONBOARDING_TAILSCALE_INSTALL_THEN_CONNEC: After Tailscale is installed, this panel will offer a Log In with Tailscale button automatically.
APP_ACTION_OPEN_LOCALLY_DESC: This app's public address isn't reachable right now, but it's still serving on your local network.
MEMORY_CONNECT_BLOCKED_HUB_NOT_PROVISION: This Hub doesn't have a public address yet, so it can't run the connect flow.
MEMORY_CONNECT_BLOCKED_HUB_UNREACHABLE: Your Hub's public address isn't reachable right now. Connect from a device on the same network, or try again once it's back.
MEMORY_CONNECT_BLOCKED_PROVIDER_LOCAL_ON: CI Memory is only available on your local network. Connect from a device on the same network.
